_about: Facts kept off air until checked or fixed. Delete a line to release the fact. Review 09 OCT 26 of Mike's first Abu Dhabi file.
ABU_STAT_POLE: says nine of ten 2015-2024 wins came from pole; by our count it is ten of ten
F1_MOM_2020_MNZ: Hamilton's 2020 Monza penalty was a stop-go in the race, not a grid penalty
F1_RACE_RATE: the arithmetic is wrong: at 0.3 s a lap a 2 s gap reaches DRS range in about 3-4 laps
F1_RACE_DRS_WINDOW: 'harvest ERS battery power' inside the DRS window is wrong
ABU_T14_01: Turn 14 is old-layout numbering (2018); needs the location under the current layout
ABU_LORE_2012: misquotes the radio message and repeats ABU_HIST_2012_01
ABU_T02_01: Turns 2-3 are not uphill; Yas Marina is flat
F1_RACE_DIRTY_AIR: the 10-15 degree figure has no checkable source
F1_RACE_SOFT: the three-to-five-tenths figure has no checkable source
ABU_T07_01: second DRS zone placement disagrees with hoover_tracks.json (turn eight to Marsa Corner)
